Subject: Re: Budget Increase Request

Dear [Recipient Name],

Thank you for reviewing our recent budget increase request. We appreciate the feedback regarding the alignment with the company’s current financial strategy.

We understand that the initial justification did not sufficiently demonstrate the value of the proposed increase. To address this, we are preparing a revised submission that includes a more detailed explanation and concrete examples of the anticipated benefits, ensuring it aligns closely with our strategic goals.

We will share the updated proposal with you shortly for your review.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

***
